The Northern Maiden at the Raven Rock docks, the return route to the Windhelm docks in Skyrim. Travel is free once the first crossing has been paid.
Nord mead hall on Lake Fjalding in northern Solstheim, taken over by Rieklings when first visited. The player can side with the Nords or the Rieklings to retake it.
Giant mushroom tower of the Telvanni wizard Neloth on the eastern coast of Solstheim. Neloth offers Enchanting training and several quests, including the Black Book The Hidden Twilight.
All-Maker stone in northwestern Solstheim enslaved by Miraak; freeing it starts the Skaal quest line. Restored, it grants the North Wind power.
All-Maker stone on the western coast of Solstheim. Once cleansed it grants the Waters of Life power.

All-Maker stone in central Solstheim near the Temple of Miraak. Restored, it grants the Conjure Werebear power.
Village of the Skaal Nords in northeastern Solstheim, keepers of the old ways and the All-Maker. Storn and Frea guide the player against Miraak and the smith can teach stalhrim.
Dunmer colony of House Redoran on the southern coast of Solstheim, the island's only town. It has a Temple, the Retching Netch inn, an ebony mine and the Severin Manor player home.
A dock in Solstheim inhabited by mudcrabs, old salty ancarion, thalmor soldiers. Notable loot: East Empire Pendant.
Ruined tower in northeastern Solstheim taken over by the rogue Telvanni Ildari Sarothril. Neloth's quest Old Friends ends here.
Ruined fortress in southern Solstheim used by the Morag Tong. It is the final stop of Served Cold, the quest to save Councilor Morvayn.

Nordic tomb in northern Solstheim overrun by spider-breeding cultists. The dragon priest Dukaan and the Black Book The Sallow Regent are inside, with a Cyclone word wall in the connected White Ridge Sanctum.
Buried Nordic tomb south of Raven Rock excavated over several visits in Unearthed. It holds the dragon priest Ahzidal, his relics, the Black Book Filament and Filigree and a Cyclone word wall.
Colossal temple in the center of Solstheim where enslaved islanders build for Miraak. Frea leads the player to the Black Book Waking Dreams, and a word wall teaches part of Dragon Aspect.
Half-sunken Dwemer city on the eastern coast of Solstheim, explored with Neloth in The Path of Knowledge. Restoring its pumps reveals the Black Book Epistolary Acumen.
A landmark in Solstheim inhabited by horkers, lord tusk. Notable loot: Horksbane.
Tomb of the pirate king Haknir Death-Brand on Horker Island, opened with an ancient Nordic pickaxe. The quest Deathbrand rewards the unique stalhrim armor set.
A cave in Solstheim inhabited by bristlebacks, rieklings.
Ruined Imperial fort on the southern ash coast of Solstheim, now held by ash spawn. General Falx Carius returns from the dead here in the quest March of the Dead.
Small Dwemer ruin in central Solstheim opened with resonance gems collected around the island. Winning its arena trials grants a Dwarven sphere and a Dwarven spider companion.
Large Dwemer ruin in northern Solstheim with a boilery puzzle. The Visage of Mzund helmet is the reward for solving it.
Ruins of the frost giant Karstaag's castle in northwestern Solstheim. Returning his skull to the throne summons him for a very hard fight.

Nordic tomb reached through Raven Rock Mine, guarded by the dragon priest Zahkriisos. The Bloodskal Blade opens its energy door and the Black Book The Winds of Change is inside.
